newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Telebras still strong buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Telebras still strong buy.

text.p: -- Bear, Stearns & Co said in a report that it has reiterated its strong buy recommendation on Brazilian federal telecoms giant Telebras.
-- The brokerage also said it was maintaining its 12-month price target of $95 per Telebras American Depositary Share (ADS).
-- Bear, Stearns cited the company's just-released unaudited 11-month financial results, saying year-to-date earnings reached $7.34 per ADS.
-- "We believe Telebras is on a trajectory to meet our $8 per ADS full-year 1996 earnings forecast," it added.
-- The brokerage said Telebras installed an additional 170,000 lines in November, the same accelerated rate of new line growth as October.
-- It said Telebras' cellular subscriber base also grew faster than expected.
-- "The critical issue facing Telebras is tariff rebalancing, which we expected in November-December 1996", but now may not occur until after March, Bear Stearns said.

-- However, "a brief delay in the implementation of the new tariff regime may not jeopardize our full-year 1997 earnings forecast, or our current valuation of Telebras in any significant way," it added.
-- Telebras preferred was up 0.25 percent at 80.05 reais, while its voting common was up 0.41 percent at 74.00 reais at 1448 local/1148 EST on the Sao Paulo bolsa.
-- Its ADR traded up 3/4 at 77 1/8 reais at 1452 local/1152 EST in New York.
